evidence_chain: FACT: Karman’s Q1 2026 10-Q says revenue is generated primarily from design, development, and deployment of Propulsion Systems, Aerodynamic Interstage Systems, and Payload Protection and Deployment Systems across Hypersonic and Strategic Missile Defense, Missile and Integrated Defense Systems, Space and Launch, and Maritime Defense Systems. Source: SEC 10-Q filed May 13, 2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2040127/000119312526222116/krmn-20260331.htm

FACT: Karman reported Q1 2026 revenue of $151.210 million and backlog of $1.026903 billion, compared with Q1 2025 revenue of $100.124 million and backlog of $636.350 million. Source: SEC 10-Q filed May 13, 2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2040127/000119312526222116/krmn-20260331.htm

FACT: Karman’s 2025 10-K says that once a supplier has been qualified on a program and delivers quality, management believes a prime integrator is typically unlikely to pursue requalification given a relatively lengthy and costly process. Source: SEC 10-K for fiscal year 2025, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2040127/000204012726000014/krmn-20251231.htm

FACT: Karman’s 2025 10-K disclosed $801.1 million of backlog as of December 31, 2025 and warned that government customers may terminate, modify, curtail, or not exercise options, so backlog may not fully convert to revenue. Source: SEC 10-K for fiscal year 2025, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2040127/000204012726000014/krmn-20251231.htm

FACT: Karman announced on January 5, 2026 that Systima received $5.0 million in Defense Production Act Title III funding to expand capacity to produce solid rocket motor nozzles, including an additional dedicated SRM nozzle production line and optimized production cell for complex nozzles. Source: Karman investor release, https://investors.karman-sd.com/News--Events/press-releases/news-details/2026/Pentagon-Awards-Systima-Part-of-Karman-Space--Defense-5-Million-to-Expand-Solid-Rocket-Motor-Nozzle-Production-Capacity/default.aspx

FACT: Karman’s January 2026 release says it has designed, produced, and delivered SRM nozzles for key missile programs for several decades. Source: Karman investor release, https://investors.karman-sd.com/News--Events/press-releases/news-details/2026/Pentagon-Awards-Systima-Part-of-Karman-Space--Defense-5-Million-to-Expand-Solid-Rocket-Motor-Nozzle-Production-Capacity/default.aspx

FACT: CNAS argued in May 2026 that the defense industrial base is shallow and fragile, that private capital has flowed mainly to would-be tier-one companies, and that subtier suppliers remain exposed to uneven demand signals and appropriations. Source: CNAS, The Invisible Industrial Base, https://www.cnas.org/publications/commentary/new-dib-rue

FACT: Breaking Defense reported in April 2026 that tariff impacts on defense firms were muted by national-security exemptions, but the administrative burden of seeking exemptions is heavier for small companies than primes. Source: Breaking Defense, https://breakingdefense.com/2026/04/a-year-after-liberation-day-impact-of-trump-tariffs-on-defense-industry-remains-muted/

FACT: As of June 11, 2026, a market-data lookup showed KRMN market capitalization around $6.23 billion, placing it in the mid-cap bucket under this framework. Source: web finance data retrieved June 11, 2026.

INFERENCE: The combination of DPA-linked SRM nozzle capacity expansion, disclosed propulsion/interstage/payload systems, and management’s qualification-stickiness language supports the hypothesis that Karman may sit in a qualification-constrained lower-tier supply node.

HYPOTHESIS: Karman’s public-market exposure may be unusually pure for a mid-cap supplier tied to missile, hypersonic, space-launch, and SRM component bottlenecks, but the thesis requires program-level revenue/backlog verification.

SPECULATION: If SRM nozzle capacity is a true gating item for missile production and if Karman is one of few qualified suppliers on major production programs, its strategic value could exceed what broad aerospace/defense classifications imply. This is not yet proven by public filings.
falsification_plan: CN: 若未来 10-K/10-Q、earnings call 或 investor deck 显示大部分收入来自非导弹、非 SRM、非超高音速、非战略项目的普通结构件或商业空间项目，则下调 thesis。EN: Downgrade the thesis if future filings/calls/decks show most revenue comes from ordinary structures or commercial space work rather than missile, SRM, hypersonic, or strategic programs.

CN: 若 backlog 主要为短周期、低毛利、prototype-heavy 或未进入 funded programs of record 的订单，则下调。EN: Downgrade if backlog is mainly short-cycle, low-margin, prototype-heavy, or not linked to funded programs of record.

CN: 若 USAspending、SAM.gov、DPA、prime award 或 DoD budget docs 无法进一步佐证 Karman/Systima 与 SRM 喷管、导弹防御、超高音速或战术导弹生产项目的绑定，则保持 hypothesis、不升级。EN: Keep the thesis as only a hypothesis if USAspending, SAM.gov, DPA, prime-award, or DoD budget documents do not further corroborate Karman/Systima ties to SRM nozzles, missile defense, hypersonics, or tactical missile production.

CN: 若竞争对手或 primes 自建产能使 SRM 喷管、热防护、整流罩或级间段不再是扩产瓶颈，则 falsify gating-item 版本 thesis。EN: Falsify the gating-item version if competitors or primes add enough in-house capacity that SRM nozzles, thermal protection, fairings/shrouds, or interstages are no longer production bottlenecks.

CN: 若客户能在一个正常采购周期内替换 Karman 且无明显 requalification 成本、质量风险或交付延迟，则“长认证周期卡点”被证伪。EN: Falsify the qualification-stickiness thesis if customers can switch away from Karman within a normal procurement cycle without meaningful requalification costs, quality risk, or delivery delay.

CN: 若毛利率/Adjusted EBITDA margin 随产能扩张和收购整合显著恶化，说明增长可能是低质量或执行成本过高。EN: If gross margin or Adjusted EBITDA margin deteriorates materially as capacity expands and acquisitions integrate, growth may be lower quality or execution costs may be too high.
deep_reports.hidden_signal_to_verify: CN: 需要验证的隐藏信号是：Karman/Systima 的收入、backlog 和新增订单中，有多少直接绑定 SRM 喷管、导弹防御、战术导弹、超高音速、战略威慑、大直径导弹、UAS 和空间发射 production programs；这些组件是否属于长认证周期、少数合格供应商、产能受限、替代成本高的环节；DPA Title III 资金是否说明 SRM 喷管确实是美国弹药工业基础的关键节点。EN: The hidden signal to verify is the share of Karman/Systima revenue, backlog, and new awards tied directly to SRM nozzles, missile defense, tactical missiles, hypersonics, strategic deterrence, large-diameter missiles, UAS, and space-launch production programs; whether those components have long qualification cycles, few qualified suppliers, constrained capacity, and high switching costs; and whether the DPA Title III funding indicates that SRM nozzles are a recognized critical node in the U.S. munitions industrial base.
next_research_tasks: CN: 逐页抽取 KRMN S-1、2025 10-K、2026 10-Q、8-K 和 investor presentation 中的 end-market revenue、backlog、remaining performance obligations、customer concentration、program examples 和 margin bridge。EN: Extract from KRMN’s S-1, 2025 10-K, 2026 10-Q, 8-Ks, and investor presentations: end-market revenue, backlog, remaining performance obligations, customer concentration, program examples, and margin bridge.

CN: 用 USAspending、SAM.gov、DPA Title III、DoD contract announcements 搜索 Karman、Systima、Metal Technology、Seemann、MSC 等实体，建立合同/项目/金额/期限表。EN: Search USAspending, SAM.gov, DPA Title III, and DoD contract announcements for Karman, Systima, Metal Technology, Seemann, MSC, and related subsidiaries; build a contract/program/value/duration table.

CN: 对照 FY2027 NDAA、DoD budget justification、MDA、Army missiles、Navy missiles、USAF strategic systems、hypersonics line items，标记哪些项目可能需要 Karman 组件。EN: Map FY2027 NDAA, DoD budget justifications, MDA, Army missile, Navy missile, USAF strategic-system, and hypersonic line items to programs that may require Karman components.

CN: 搜索 prime contractor 公告和供应商质量/认证文件，确认 Karman/Systima 是否在关键项目上为 sole-source、single-source、qualified-source、preferred supplier 或 long-term agreement supplier。EN: Search prime-contractor releases and supplier quality/qualification documents to determine whether Karman/Systima is sole-source, single-source, qualified-source, preferred supplier, or covered by long-term agreements on key programs.

CN: 分析 DPA Title III 资金条款：$5 million 是否只是小额设备补贴，还是代表 DoD 认定 SRM nozzle capacity 为关键 supply-chain vulnerability。EN: Analyze the DPA Title III award terms: determine whether the $5 million is merely equipment support or evidence that DoD views SRM nozzle capacity as a critical supply-chain vulnerability.

CN: 建立同行/替代供应商列表：SRM 喷管、热防护、复材整流罩、级间段、payload deployment 和 refractory metals 领域有哪些私有/上市供应商，Karman 的差异在哪里。EN: Build a peer/substitute list across SRM nozzles, thermal protection, composite fairings/shrouds, interstages, payload deployment, and refractory metals; identify where Karman differs.

CN: 监控 Q2/Q3 2026：backlog conversion、book-to-bill、gross margin、Adjusted EBITDA margin、capex、headcount、facility expansion、Systima production line milestones、客户集中变化。EN: Monitor Q2/Q3 2026 backlog conversion, book-to-bill, gross margin, Adjusted EBITDA margin, capex, headcount, facility expansion, Systima production-line milestones, and customer concentration.

CN: 检查市场是否已经充分定价：比较 KRMN 的增长、margin、backlog visibility、客户集中、估值倍数与其他 defense/space suppliers；仅作为市场定价检查，不形成交易建议。EN: Check market pricing by comparing KRMN’s growth, margins, backlog visibility, customer concentration, and valuation multiples with other defense/space suppliers; use only as a pricing sanity check, not a trading recommendation.
risks: CN: 收入 mix 风险：公开披露的 end markets 不等于所有收入都来自 SRM、导弹、超高音速或战略项目；若 Space & Launch、general aerospace 或非瓶颈结构件占比更高，卡点 thesis 会被削弱。EN: Revenue-mix risk: disclosed end markets do not prove that most revenue comes from SRM, missile, hypersonic, or strategic programs; if Space & Launch, general aerospace, or non-bottleneck structures dominate, the chokepoint thesis weakens.

CN: Backlog 质量风险：10-K 明确提示政府客户可不行使选项、终止、修改或缩减项目，backlog 不一定全部转化为收入。EN: Backlog-quality risk: the 10-K explicitly warns that government customers can fail to exercise options or terminate, modify, or curtail programs, so backlog may not fully convert to revenue.

CN: 替代性风险：公司管理层称 requalification 通常 lengthy and costly，但这不等于 Karman 在每个项目上都是唯一或不可替代供应商。EN: Substitutability risk: management says requalification is often lengthy and costly, but that does not prove Karman is sole-source or irreplaceable on each program.

CN: 产能扩建风险：DPA Title III 资金说明政府关注 SRM 喷管产能，但也可能吸引其他供应商扩产，长期削弱瓶颈溢价。EN: Capacity-expansion risk: DPA Title III funding indicates government concern over SRM nozzle capacity, but it may also catalyze competing capacity and reduce long-term bottleneck rents.

CN: 客户集中和项目延迟风险：低层供应商可能高度依赖少数 prime integrators 或关键项目，任何 program slip、预算延迟、采购节奏变化都可能放大收入波动。EN: Customer-concentration and program-delay risk: subtier suppliers may depend heavily on a few prime integrators or programs, so slips, budget delays, and procurement timing changes can magnify revenue volatility.

CN: 估值/预期风险：中型新上市防务供应商在高增长叙事下可能被提前定价；本报告不提供买卖建议、目标价或收益承诺。EN: Valuation/expectations risk: newly public mid-cap defense suppliers can be priced ahead of fundamentals under a high-growth narrative; this report does not provide buy/sell advice, target prices, or return promises.

CN: 政策与合规成本风险：外部证据显示小型/低层供应商更难承担关税豁免、合规、行政和资金周转负担。EN: Policy and compliance-cost risk: external evidence indicates smaller/lower-tier suppliers may face heavier relative burdens from tariff exemptions, compliance, administration, and working capital.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: CN: 供应链层级可拆为：1) 政策/需求端：美国国防工业基础韧性、导弹补库存、战略威慑、导弹防御、超高音速、空间和 UAS；2) 主承包商/系统集成商：大型导弹、推进、空间发射和防务平台公司；3) 推进与结构子系统：SRM、喷管、热防护、整流罩、级间段、载荷保护和部署系统；4) Karman 可能所在位置：面向 prime integrators 和政府/商业空间客户的 mission-critical subsystems 与结构/推进相邻组件；5) 验证重点：Karman 是否处在已经进入 production specification 的合格供应商名单、是否有长周期复审/替代成本、是否存在产能瓶颈。EN: Supply-chain map: 1) policy/demand: U.S. defense industrial-base resilience, missile replenishment, strategic deterrence, missile defense, hypersonics, space, and UAS; 2) primes/system integrators: large missile, propulsion, space-launch, and defense-platform contractors; 3) propulsion and structural subsystems: SRMs, nozzles, thermal protection, shrouds/fairings, interstages, payload protection, and deployment systems; 4) Karman’s likely node: mission-critical subsystems and propulsion-adjacent/structural components sold to prime integrators and government/commercial space customers; 5) validation focus: whether Karman is embedded in production specifications, whether requalification is lengthy/costly, and whether capacity is a gating constraint.
deep_reports.thesis_cn: 假设：Karman 可能不是普通航天/国防零部件公司，而是处在美国导弹、超高音速、UAS、空间发射和固体火箭发动机供应链中较难替代的合格组件层。其潜在卡点包括 Propulsion Systems、Aerodynamic Interstage Systems、Payload Protection and Deployment Systems，以及 Systima 相关的 SRM 喷管产能。该判断的核心不在于“国防预算上涨”这个显性故事，而在于低层供应商资格认证、工艺经验、产能建设和 program-spec 嵌入可能导致替代周期长。当前证据支持继续深挖，但还不足以直接证明 Karman 对关键导弹或 SRM 项目具有单点瓶颈控制力。
deep_reports.thesis_en: Hypothesis: Karman may be more than a generic aerospace and defense component company; it may sit in a hard-to-substitute qualified component layer for U.S. missile, hypersonic, UAS, space-launch, and solid-rocket-motor supply chains. Potential chokepoints include Propulsion Systems, Aerodynamic Interstage Systems, Payload Protection and Deployment Systems, and Systima-linked SRM nozzle capacity. The core signal is not simply higher defense spending, but qualification stickiness, embedded program specifications, specialized manufacturing processes, and capacity expansion at lower tiers. Current evidence supports deeper research, but does not yet prove Karman has single-point bottleneck control over critical missile or SRM programs.
deep_reports.title_cn: Karman Holdings：导弹、超高音速与固体火箭发动机低层供应链卡点假设
deep_reports.title_en: Karman Holdings: A Subtier Chokepoint Hypothesis in Missiles, Hypersonics, and Solid Rocket Motors
deep_reports.why_underfollowed: CN: Karman 是新近上市且业务标签容易被归入 broad aerospace、space 或 defense parts，市场注意力容易被大型 primes、导弹整机商、火箭公司和热门防务科技初创公司吸走。真正可能的隐蔽信号在较低层：喷管、整流罩、热防护、级间段、部署系统、特种材料/工艺、资格认证和产能扩建。这类供应商通常不会出现在新闻标题中，但若进入关键项目生产规范，替换成本可能高于其收入规模所暗示的水平。EN: Karman is newly public and can be bucketed as broad aerospace, space, or defense parts, while investor attention tends to concentrate on primes, missile OEMs, launch companies, and high-profile defense-tech startups. The hidden signal sits lower in the stack: nozzles, shrouds/fairings, thermal protection, interstages, deployment systems, specialized materials/processes, qualification status, and capacity additions. These suppliers rarely dominate headlines, but once embedded in program specifications, switching costs may be higher than revenue size suggests.

evidence.supports: Karman Q1 2026 revenue, backlog, end-market definitions, and system categories.
Backlog risk, qualification-stickiness language, government funding risk, and remaining performance obligations.
Systima DPA Title III funding to expand SRM nozzle capacity and Karman’s claim of decades-long SRM nozzle support for key missile programs.
Macro rationale for looking below primes: subtier defense suppliers are shallow, fragile, and exposed to uneven demand and appropriations.
Small defense companies may face heavier administrative/legal burdens from tariff exemptions than large primes.
KRMN market capitalization was approximately $6.23 billion during the June 11, 2026 lookup, consistent with mid-cap classification.

memory_update.value: Maintain as underfollowed mid-cap chokepoint hypothesis; evidence upgraded by 2026 10-Q backlog/end-market disclosure and Systima DPA Title III SRM nozzle capacity award, but program-level revenue/backlog mix and sole/qualified-source status still unverified.

Upgrade if filings, DoD/DPA/USAspending data, or prime-contractor disclosures quantify material revenue/backlog from SRM nozzles, tactical missiles, missile defense, hypersonics, strategic systems, or production programs of record and show long qualification cycles or limited qualified suppliers.

Downgrade or falsify if revenue/backlog is mainly general aerospace/commercial space/prototype work, if components are build-to-print commodity parts with many qualified alternatives, or if capacity expansion by primes/competitors removes Karman’s gating role.

summary: CN: Karman Holdings Inc. 的 Layer 5 结论是：其“普通航天/国防零部件公司”标签可能低估了其在导弹、超高音速、战术导弹、战略导弹防御、空间发射和固体火箭发动机组件中的合格供应商属性。最强证据来自公司 2026 年 10-Q 披露的四个核心终端市场、10-K 对供应商资格认证和复审成本的描述，以及 2026 年 1 月 Systima 获得 DPA Title III 资金扩建 SRM 喷管产能的公告。该 thesis 仍应保持“hypothesis / 待验证”状态，因为公开披露尚未充分量化 SRM、喷管、超高音速、导弹防御和战略项目在收入/backlog 中的精确占比，也未完全证明 Karman 是不可替代 gating item。EN: The Layer 5 view on Karman Holdings Inc. is that the market may be under-reading it as a generic aerospace/defense parts supplier rather than a qualified subtier supplier embedded in missile, hypersonic, tactical missile, strategic missile defense, space-launch, and solid-rocket-motor component chains. The strongest evidence comes from Karman’s 2026 10-Q end-market disclosures, its 2025 10-K discussion of supplier qualification stickiness, and the January 2026 announcement that Systima received DPA Title III funding to expand SRM nozzle capacity. The thesis remains a hypothesis because public filings do not yet precisely quantify SRM/nozzle/hypersonic/strategic-program revenue or prove that Karman is a true gating bottleneck rather than one qualified supplier among several.
